family.description: This entry represents the coiled-coil region of Coiled-coil domain-containing protein 113 (CCDC113, also known as cilia- and flagella-associated protein 263, CFAP263) and coiled-coil domain-containing protein 96 (CCDC96, also known as cilia- and flagella-associated protein 184, CFAP184) [[cite:PUB00159884],[cite:PUB00153410]]. These proteins form a complex and regulate ciliary beating that connects radial spoke 3 (RS3) to the inner dynein arm (IDA) and the nexin-dynein regulatory complex (N-DRC). The complex is positioned parallel to N-DRC and forms a connection between the arch at the base of RS3, the IDA tail and N-DRC [[cite:PUB00159884]].
family.name: CCDC113/CCDC96, coiled-coil
